name: qa-feature-pipeline
description: End-to-end QA pipeline for Language Learner features: resolve requirement gaps from Docs/ & source, generate QA test-model/test-suite/coverage-report via qa-architect, automate P0/P1/P2 Robolectric Compose tests, run Gradle & fix failures, run wiki/lint.py, and optionally commit & push.

run_date.description: Date prefix for qa-artifacts/<run_date>-<slug>/ (defaults to today's YYYY-MM-DD).

priorities.description: Priorities to automate in Stage 4 (e.g. 'p0' or 'p0,p1,p2').

resolve_gaps.description: Whether to resolve PRD gaps using Docs/psd/<slug>.md, Docs/tests/<slug>.md, and source files before Stage 3.

commit_and_push.description: Whether to git add, commit, and push after all tests and wiki/lint.py pass.
